description: dict(original) in MemoryStore._resolve_work_sources given a source reference written as key/value pairs (state consolidation: the memory port's own dict() copy raised the StateError 'value must contain finite JSON data' at the first non-string key; the shared PyNode.DictWith reads every pair first, as CPython 3.13's dict() does, so a later unhashable key or wrong-length pair raises TypeError/ValueError). Python callers pass normalised references; the library accepts any value.
